title: Towards a Hybrid Quantum Enhanced Solution for Densest k-Subgraph Problem
summary: We study the application of Gaussian Boson Sampling (GBS) to the densest k-subgraph problem (DkSP). GBS with hard post-selection suffers from poor sampling efficiency due to strict cardinality constraints. To address this limitation, we introduce effective classical post-processing strategies that transform, otherwise discarded, near-k samples into feasible solutions.
